content.intro: Learn localization (l10n) through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Localization (l10n) matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines localization (l10n) as part of localization, accessibility, and user experience. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: Locale-specific date and number formats; Language and locale selection; Formatting currency; Time-zone-aware presentation; Cultural considerations in user interfaces. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Common pitfalls include skipping a required configuration/import, copying a fragment without its model or URL context, trusting client input, or treating a development-only behavior as production-ready. Check the earliest failing assumption, consult the version-specific docs, and add a regression test for the failure you found.
